competitor_research.observation: Enabled AST rules run at relevant points of the checker traversal with semantic context; individual rules can perform additional traversals. Expression analysis dispatches by node kind and enabled rules.
competitor_research.inference: Repeated per-rule relation evaluation is a plausible source of excess Ryo work; source architecture alone does not quantify runtime or justify cross-rule cache semantics.
competitor_research.measured_evidence: Django prefix136244rule intervals sum57.066s/60s andpipeline95.43%inclusive in separateprofile;storedRHS optimization is separately gated narrowcomparison.

related_architecture_observations.observation: Shared arena-backed AST and compiler infrastructure; visitors work over borrowed nodes.
related_architecture_observations.ryo_hypothesis: Avoid repeated row materialization and make operation lifetimes explicit; architecture is not a measured Ryo speedup.

related_architecture_observations.observation: Current Oxlint type-aware backend uses direct typescript-go AST, a shared Program/file queue, separate checker per workload and node-kind rule listeners.
related_architecture_observations.ryo_hypothesis: Separate shared immutable semantic facts from mutable per-operation state; a reusable cache needs its own proven lifetime and identity.

related_architecture_observations.observation: Default preserves pinned checker behavior; fast opts into adaptive counts, grouping and caches. Diagnostics can depend on file order/checker count. Benchmarks pin project inputs/overlays, mostly enable fast explicitly, and release comparisons measure default plus fast.
related_architecture_observations.ryo_hypothesis: Pin mode, worker count, input order and cache lifecycle; do not silently substitute an adaptive configuration.

announcement_context.claims: Up to8x and about70%less memory vsTypeScript7.0 with equal checker counts; TypeScript7.1beta itself up to2.5x vs7.0.
announcement_context.limits: These are upstream TypeScript measurements, not Ryo predictions. Current README default/fast distinction supersedes announcement adaptive-default wording. tsrs integration into Oxlint was described as future exploration, not the current type-aware backend.

mode_semantics.observation: Lazy type members; declaration parsing only when declaration checking is skipped; eligible noEmit/nonincremental/nonwatch leaf freeing. Fast scheduling/history/instantiation can add/remove diagnostics or change locations/messages/exit status despite unchanged strict options. History/lazy settings reject incompatible build caches. Single-thread mode avoids checker-state duplication; maxMemory replaces the largest checker and trades CPU for memory.
mode_semantics.ryo_hypothesis: Demand-driven phases and context-keyed bounded state need explicit lifetime/eligibility and diagnostic-equivalence tests; fast mode is not guaranteed semantically equivalent.
